steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: The gangsters ahead aren't on our side, so be careful and go around them.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: It's lucky that someone is causing trouble on the roof and drawing the attention of the enemies.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: Catch her!! She's a Sinner!! She can be very useful!!
You are too far away and can only make out that she is an archer. She is pretty strong fighting against so many on her own.
It's just that the figure drawing the bow looks somewhat familiar.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She's very outnumbered. She's not gonna last long.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: Save her.|Slip away now.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ah, hold on, isn't that <color=#fb9259>EMP</color>? I remember her. She's the guy who got locked up nearby.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: You think you can trap me, "the Archer Queen of Syndicate?"
Oh, it's her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That sassy bow-drawing posture is too distinctive.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ah, that stupid hat—Aren't you Hella, the loser?! You're here just in time.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Are you in awe of my heroic posture? Let me reward you with a chance to fight alongside "the Archer Queen of Syndicate!"

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: It's now or never. I can still treat you to a big bowl of Syndican noodles when this is over!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...That dumbass isn't gonna hold out any longer.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She is a fugitive Sinner, S-107. Danger Rating: B, which is the same as Hella. Arrest difficulty: Low.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm not on the same rating as that dumbass!!! Hecate, where's your respect?!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content:
Wait, what's that one-eyed gloomy idiot doing here? And the new Chief?
Hella, since when did you start working for the Bureau as a lapdog?!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: And even working for the Chief who got beaten up by me and hid behind people's back like a loser?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I've changed my mind. Arrest her now.

steps.content:
She looks like she can be a good fighter.
Besides, she treated you so “well”, it only makes sense to pay it back.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hmm... Interesting. No one in the whole Syndicate can take my arrows.
Her fierce arrow flies past the gangs around her and shoots straight at the ground in front of you. The arc of electricity left by the arrow draws the attention of all the rioters toward you.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: Oh, isn't that Ted? He's got two Sinners with him. Hehe... What a treat!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Come on, I will beat you all up by myself!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stop drawing them toward us, you jerk!
